parameters.onRowPressed: Receives the row the reader activates.
parameters.sortColumn: The column the rows are sorted by, for the header's indicator.
parameters.sortAscending: Whether the sorted column runs up.
parameters.onSort: Receives the chosen column and sort direction.
parameters.emptyLabel: The quiet line a table with no rows prints under its header.
parameters.minWidth: Sets the minimum table width before horizontal scrolling.
